title: Colin and Maddy's Great Moon Trip
plot: Moon Trip Night: Colin drives his bright orange police pickup truck to the launch pad, then rides a silver rocket to the moon with Maddy, Bolt, and Luna the moon rabbit, fixes the leaning Starlight Antenna, and joins a Moonlight Parade before riding home

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Jungle Waterfall Quest
plot: Jungle Waterfall Quest: Colin drives his big orange dump truck through the jungle with Maddy, Bolt, Kiki the monkey, Tiko the toucan, and Lulu the lemur, clears a boulder, fixes a vine bridge, unblocks the waterfall pool, and ends with a waterfall picnic and jungle concert

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Invention Fair
plot: Invention Fair Day: Colin drives his bright orange firefighting pickup truck while Maddy, Bolt, Cora the crow, Benny the beaver, and Pip the mouse mechanic chase a runaway bubble that carries off the golden prize wrench, and end with a bubble parade and picnic

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Talent Show
plot: Talent Show Day: Colin drives his big orange crane truck to set up the meadow amphitheater stage while Maddy, Bolt, Freddie the frog, Daisy the duckling, and Ollie the otter perform, and help shy Lulu the lark find her song

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Ski Lodge Adventure
plot: Ski Lodge Day: Colin drives his big orange excavator to clear the snowy road to the lodge while Maddy, Bolt, Pip the penguin, Fern the arctic fox kit, Opal the snowy owl, and Sami the seal pup build a ski jump, help shy Hazel the snowshoe hare find her burrow, and end with a lantern-lit sunset ski parade

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Ice Skating Party
plot: Skating Day: Colin drives his bright orange police pickup truck to plow the snow off Frosty Pond while Maddy, Bolt, Pippa the penguin, Ollie the otter, Willa the wren, and Freddie the fox kit skate, help shy Dilly the duckling glide, and end with a lantern skate under the stars

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Sandcastle Festival
plot: Beach Day: Colin's orange police pickup truck hauls wet sand while Maddy, Bolt, Coral the crab, Sandy the starfish, and Pippin the pelican build the biggest sandcastle town ever, rescue their wind-blown flag, save a runaway beach ball, and march in a lantern-lit Sandcastle Festival parade

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Sunset Shell Parade
plot: Sunset Beach Day: Colin's orange firefighting pickup clears the parade path and mists a cool trail while Maddy, Bolt, Bubbles the baby dolphin, Shelly the baby sea turtle, and Sunny the seagull collect shells for the Sunset Shell Parade and help shy Shelly take her very first swim

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Snow Fort Build
plot: Snow Fort Day at Frosty Meadow: Colin's orange dump truck hauls snow blocks while Maddy, Bolt, Pip the polar bear cub, Fern the arctic fox kit, Opal the snowy owl, and Sami the seal pup build the biggest snow fort ever, rescue their wind-blown flag, and warm up with cocoa inside their glowing fort

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Rainbow Chase
plot: A rainbow chase across Sunny Meadow: Colin's firefighting pickup mists a tiny rainbow into the sky while Maddy, Bolt, Daisy the duckling, Freddie the frog, Amber the fox kit, and Sunny the sparrow follow the big rainbow to the old oak tree and help shy baby rainbow finch Rosie find her way home before a rainbow picnic

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Firefly Lantern Night
plot: Firefly Lantern Night: Colin and Maddy ride the big red firetruck with Daddy driving and Mommy in the back with a picnic basket of fresh cookies, grapes, strawberries and peaches, plus Bolt the robot unicorn, up Firefly Hill; they hang paper lanterns with the firetruck ladder, help Hoot the baby owl who is afraid of the dark follow Bolt's glowing horn to the party, share cookies and fruit, picnic under the stars, and ride home under the lantern light

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Harvest Fair Picnic

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Pumpkin Patch Harvest

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Moonlight Camping Trip

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Berry Picking Adventure

title: Colin and Maddy's Great Snowy Sledding Day
